name: playboy-archiv-mobile
description: Mobile Android app wrapper for the existing Playboy Archiv web application.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android && npm run android:brand
scripts.cap:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:run: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.android:setup: npm run android:add && npm run android:brand && npm run cap:sync
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:setup && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
